root_causes.false_mobile_soc_debt_postprocessing: The scientific model's solved E[1]/DE[1] state was overwritten by a serialized-control reconstruction that could lose repE and invent support debt. The coupled E+DE ceiling is necessary for the fixed-location no-consumption policy but is not a general mobile-policy capacity constraint because future movement and committed work can create SOC headroom.
root_causes.immutable_h0_connected_reserve: A prospective one-connected-PCS reserve was incorrectly imposed on H0 even when the PRE state had all units in an already committed MOVE or CONNECTION_DELAY. H0 is now audited as immutable; the reserve is imposed only on controllable future stay domains.
root_causes.saturated_fd_coordinate_abort: One PCS coordinate on the P/S boundary had no feasible finite-difference probe and aborted the complete AC recovery although other P/Q coordinates remained controllable.
root_causes.unnormalized_exact_bracket_rows: Exact complementary voltage/overload midpoint equalities were expressed in physical kW/kvar while the global residual gate is evaluated in normalized model units, creating a false 4.7517e-6 constraint violation.
root_causes.soc_serialization_dust: A solver result 0.001438 Wh above the frozen 1080 kWh capacity passed the model-unit solve but failed the stricter physical-state serializer.
root_causes.soc_floor_serialization_dust: A solver result 1.0857e-8 kWh below the frozen 440 kWh floor missed the scientific arrival-state tolerance by 8.57e-10 kWh.
root_causes.unreachable_same_pre_full_replan: The initial candidate plus ten Fresh-AC corrections consumed all eleven production candidates before the full-replan eligibility check, so ordinary GRID_CORRECTION_EXHAUSTED could never execute its intended same-PRE H54 full replan.
root_causes.fixed_location_duplicate_full_replan: For M4 the fixed H0 siting and unchanged economic model reproduced the initial dispatch, but the duplicate gate compared only with the most recent correction instead of every prior production candidate.
root_causes.tap_discontinuous_one_dimensional_bracke: Complementary voltage/line bisection remained on one P/Q segment across a discrete regulator-tap jump and exhausted the budget without returning to the independent PCS Q directions.
root_causes.artificial_anchor_gap_misclassified_as_s: A low-stress P/Q norm anchor retained a constraint-feasible incumbent, but the economic dispatch 3% optimality-gap rule was applied to that artificial candidate-generation objective and rejected it before Fresh OpenDSS validation.
